answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The hollow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pearl is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing.
